cultural.vision_reason: The picture shows a complete white embroidered cloth with colorful geometric knot motifs and a tassel, consistent with Hausa textile craftsmanship. It plausibly fits the claimed Hausa ethnicity and textile category.

physical.title: cloth; garment (?)
physical.summary: Cloth: garment (?): composed of three widths of machine woven damask hand sewn together: bleach white cotton. There is a central motif created using knots and geometric shapes embroidered in dyed yellow, red, pink, blue, black and green wool. The left hand corner is also decorated using knots and geometric shapes in the same combination of dyed wools. This corner is finished by a large purple tassels made of cotton which is formed from a continuation of the lining warps. The top edge of the textile is lined with a length of hand woven cotton composed of dyed dark and light blue cotton warps and wefts hand sewn to the cloth.
